sections.heading: What is B7G Santhe (Taste of Karnataka)?
sections.content: B7G Santhe (ಸಂತೆ, a traditional market), also searchable as Taste of Karnataka, is part of the B7G Kannada Rajyotsava 2026 celebration at Brigade 7 Gardens (B7G), Bengaluru. It is a community market where residents set up stalls to showcase their talents, products or services to the B7G community — food and beverages, handmade and creative products, shopping and lifestyle items, games and activities, and more. Karnataka-style food stalls are especially welcome. The flyer's call: "Let's make B7G Santhe a Kannada festival for all of us!"

sections.heading: When is B7G Santhe?
sections.content: B7G Santhe is on 1 November 2026, in the afternoon session of the B7G Kannada Rajyotsava programme. The 1 November programme begins at 9 AM, but the exact start time of Santhe has not been announced.

sections.heading: Who can participate in B7G Santhe? Can I put up a stall?
sections.content: Yes — B7G Santhe calls all B7G residents who are interested in putting up a stall. It is a chance to showcase your talent, hobbies, products or services to the B7G community.

sections.heading: What types of stalls can I set up at B7G Santhe?
sections.content:
B7G Santhe stall categories:
- Food & Beverages
- Handmade & Creative (for example handmade items, crafts and artwork)
- Shopping & Lifestyle
- Games & Activities (for example a games stall)
- And more — other stall ideas are welcome too.

sections.heading: Are food stalls allowed at B7G Santhe? Are Karnataka-style food stalls welcome?
sections.content: Yes — food and beverage stalls are one of the B7G Santhe categories. For food stalls, Karnataka-style food is especially welcome: the flyer gives Karnataka-flavour dishes first preference.

sections.heading: How can I participate in B7G Santhe or learn more?
sections.content: Residents interested in putting up a stall at B7G Santhe should join the designated B7G Santhe WhatsApp group to know more about participation.

sections.heading: B7G Santhe details not announced yet (WhatsApp link, fee, deadline, timings, location)
sections.content: The B7G Santhe flyer does not give a WhatsApp group link, a stall registration deadline, a stall fee, the exact afternoon timings, or where the stalls will be set up within Brigade 7 Gardens. These details have not been announced yet.

sections.heading: B7G ಸಂತೆ ಎಂದರೇನು? (Kannada)
sections.content: B7G ಸಂತೆ — ಕನ್ನಡ ರಾಜ್ಯೋತ್ಸವದ ಸಂಭ್ರಮ. ನವೆಂಬರ್ 1, 2026ರ ಮಧ್ಯಾಹ್ನ, ಬ್ರಿಗೇಡ್ 7 ಗಾರ್ಡನ್ಸ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ. ಮಳಿಗೆ ಹಾಕಲು ಆಸಕ್ತ ನಿವಾಸಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಆಹ್ವಾನ! ನಿಮ್ಮ ಪ್ರತಿಭೆ, ಹವ್ಯಾಸ, ಉತ್ಪನ್ನ ಅಥವಾ ಸೇವೆಯನ್ನು B7G ಬಳಗಕ್ಕೆ ಪರಿಚಯಿಸುವ ಅವಕಾಶ. B7G ಸಂತೆಯನ್ನು ನಮ್ಮೆಲ್ಲರ ಕನ್ನಡ ಹಬ್ಬವಾಗಿಸೋಣ! ಸಂತೆಯ ನಿಖರ ಸಮಯವನ್ನು ಇನ್ನೂ ಪ್ರಕಟಿಸಲಾಗಿಲ್ಲ.

sections.heading: B7G ಸಂತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾವ ಮಳಿಗೆಗಳನ್ನು ಹಾಕಬಹುದು? (Kannada)
sections.content:
B7G ಸಂತೆಯ ಮಳಿಗೆ ವಿಭಾಗಗಳು:
- ಊಟ–ತಿಂಡಿ (Food & Beverages)
- ಕರಕುಶಲ ವಸ್ತುಗಳು (Handmade & Creative)
- ಶಾಪಿಂಗ್ (Shopping & Lifestyle)
- ಆಟೋಟಗಳು (Games & Activities)
- ಇನ್ನೂ ಹಲವು (And more)

sections.heading: B7G ಸಂತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಊಟದ ಮಳಿಗೆ ಹಾಕಬಹುದೇ? (Kannada)
sections.content: ಹೌದು. ಊಟದ ಮಳಿಗೆಗಳಿಗೆ: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಸೊಗಡಿನ ತಿನಿಸುಗಳಿಗೆ ಮೊದಲ ಆದ್ಯತೆ.

sections.heading: B7G ಸಂತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾಗವಹಿಸುವುದು ಹೇಗೆ? (Kannada)
sections.content: ಆಸಕ್ತಿ ಇದೆಯೇ? ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಮಾಹಿತಿಗಾಗಿ B7G ಸಂತೆ ವಾಟ್ಸ್‌ಆ್ಯಪ್ ಗುಂಪಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿ. ಗುಂಪಿನ ಲಿಂಕ್, ಮಳಿಗೆ ಶುಲ್ಕ ಮತ್ತು ನೋಂದಣಿ ಕೊನೆಯ ದಿನಾಂಕವನ್ನು ಇನ್ನೂ ಪ್ರಕಟಿಸಲಾಗಿಲ್ಲ.
